meta_description: MG Painter & Gardening Leicester offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and garden services. Free quotes. Local, reliable, fully insured.
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to garden transformation, we deliver quality finishes on time and on budget across Leicester.
services_heading: Painting, Decorating & Garden Services in Leicester
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecoration and exterior painting to garden landscaping and maintenance.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Complete interior repainting and wallpapering for bedrooms, kitchens, lounges, and bathrooms. We move furniture, protect carpets, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting for fascias, soffits, doors, and windows. We use quality products designed to last and protect your Leicester home.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design and landscaping including new borders, paving, and planting schemes. Transform your outdoor space into somewhere you'll love to spend time.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and general upkeep. We keep your garden looking sharp all year round with flexible monthly or quarterly visits.

services.title: Fence & Deck Work
services.desc: Fence repairs, replacement, and staining. Decking installation, sanding, and protective sealing for a garden that's both beautiful and built to last.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Professional interior and exterior painting for shops, offices, and light commercial properties. Minimal disruption, fast turnaround, fully insured.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden and home as if it were our own family's.
about_para_1: MG Painter & Gardening has been serving Leicester and surrounding areas for over 15 years. We started out because we saw too many cowboys doing sloppy work and charging over the odds. Today we've built our reputation the right way—on reliability, honest pricing, and genuine care for our customers' homes and gardens.
about_para_2: From a two-bed terrace to a large Victorian property, from a small balcony garden to a complete landscape overhaul, we treat every job with equal attention. Our customers come back year after year because we listen, deliver what we promise, and take pride in the finish. We're fully insured, use quality materials, and respect your home as much as you do.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge done—walls, ceiling, new skirting boards. Mark was tidy, professional, finished bang on time. Quoted £800, came in at £800. No surprises, no faffing about. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Garden was a complete eyesore. Within two weeks Mark had cleared it, laid new paving, planted borders, and it's transformed. Really happy with the design—he listened to what we wanted and made it happen.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Called for a free quote on the exterior. He arrived when he said he would, gave a detailed estimate with no pressure, then got the work done in three days. The paintwork looks immaculate. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
